model_ca_reference.source: CLAUDE.md 'Served estimate: logistic model on top of the lookup' walk-forward backtest (2025-09-01..2026-09-21, forward D+1..3 days, monthly refit)
model_ca_reference.caveat: CA is scored on forward served days (every beach, every day) against the next lab result; here we score lab sample-days. Base rates differ, and AUCPR scales with the base rate, so only AUROC / within-station AUROC compare loosely across states.

state_feed.format: CSV over plain HTTPS GET, no key, no auth (the 'Export CSV' endpoints of the CWB web app)

state_feed.results_page_status: 403 Cloudflare challenge to scripted HTTP clients; a text fetch of the page returns the program text but no results (rendered client-side). Not machine-readable by us.

third_party_mirror.note: NOT an official source: a privately run site that says 'Data provided by: Florida Health'. Used only as evidence of how fresh FL DOH results are; not a candidate production feed.
